 Crush purified tourmaline into a fine powder and add equal amount of purified sulphur. Triturate with lemon juice and heat it at a high temperature of 800 degree Celsius in a sealed container. 60 mg with honey twice daily or as directed by your doctor.

fullContent:
Vaikranta Bhasma 
 Reference: Rasatantra Sara 
 INTRODUCTION 
 Vaikranta Bhasma is prepared from Tourmaline which is used in treating Ascites, anemia, asthma, diabetes etc. 
 INGREDIENTS 
 
 Purified Vaikrant [Tourmaline] 
 Purified sulphur 
 Lemon juice for triturating 
 
 METHOD OF PREPARATION 
 Crush purified tourmaline into a fine powder and add equal amount of purified sulphur. Triturate with lemon juice and heat it at a high temperature of 800 degree Celsius in a sealed container. It has to be heated 8 times to obtain a soft, dull red colored product. If it’s not soft to touch it should be heated again. 
 DOSAGE 
 60 mg with honey twice daily or as directed by your doctor. 
 This Bhasma can be mixed with 1/4th of suvarna Bhasma. Now add 60 mg each of powdered long pepper and Embelia ribes. 
 INDICATIONS 
 
 Tuberculosis 
 Weakness in old age 
 Piles 
 Anemia 
 Respiratory disorders 
 Malabsorption syndrome 
 Mouth diseases 
 Chest ailments 
 Diabetes 
 Anti-aging properties 
 Strengthens and boosts immunity 
 
 CONTRAINDICATIONS 
 
 Over dosage should be strictly avoided as it may cause severe gastritis. 
 It should be taken in the prescribed dosage for a short duration. 
 Take this medicine under stern doctor’s prescription. 
 Store away from heat and light. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
